author: Lena Marx
text:
My app said my sensor needs replacement because of error while it should have worked another 4 days. I put a claim. Do you guys know if they’ll replace it? I was at the gym and afterwards it suddenly didn’t work anymore.

Unfortunately I need to pay oop as I‘m not diabetic but have reactive hypoglycemia.

author: Cindy Hartshorn
text: They  had a pilot program where you could send used sensors and applicators back for recycling. I haven't been able to order the mail back pack for a couple  months now.

author: Stan Horwitz
text: Lena Seibertz I have submitted three claims thus far for exactly the same problem. All three were replaced for free.

author: Harvey Davis
text: Lena File the claim with Abbott who warrants the sensor and they will replace it (my ecperience). Save the defective because they will want it. Usually the replacement will arrive in 2-3 days via FedEx along with a prepaid label and return package.
